name.description: Human-readable workspace name. Used for session filename and statusline. Defaults to the workspace file's basename without extension.

folders.description: List of root folders (absolute paths or paths with ~). Neovim cd's into the first folder on open; all folders are added as LSP workspace roots.

terminals.description: Long-running named terminals. Re-launching focuses the existing buffer.

name.description: Unique identifier for :WorkspaceTermRun and buffer reuse.

folder.description: Folder basename (matched against `folders`) or absolute path. Defaults to the first workspace folder.

cmd.description: Shell command to run. Omit for a plain interactive shell.

env.description: Name of an env profile from `envs` to layer onto the spawned process.

position.description: Passed to the terminal backend (snacks.terminal). Common values: bottom, float, right.

autostart.description: Launch this terminal automatically when the workspace opens.

tasks.description: One-shot commands. Each run opens a fresh terminal split; no autostart, no reuse.

folder.description: Folder basename or absolute path. Defaults to the first workspace folder.

env.description: Name of an env profile from `envs` to layer onto the spawned process.

interactive.description: Keep the terminal open for input after the command exits (snacks backend only).

env.description: Always-on environment variables applied to vim.env when the workspace opens. Previous values are restored on close. Inherited by every terminal and task.

envs.description: Named env profiles. Reference from a terminal or task via "env": "<name>". Only the referenced profile's vars flow into that child process; Neovim's own vim.env stays on `env`.

vim_options.description: Neovim global options set on workspace open and restored on close. Keys are option names (e.g. tabstop, shiftwidth, expandtab, textwidth). Values may be string, number, or boolean.

lsp.description: Per-LSP-server config patch. Keys are server names (lua_ls, pyright, tsserver, ...). Values are merged into vim.lsp.config for that server on open; attached clients are notified via workspace/didChangeConfiguration. Reverted on close. Requires Neovim 0.11+.
